abstract: Maintains geophysical radar performance records and laboratory instrument power loads
system_message:
You are the Scientific payload lead (SCI), responsible for maintaining geophysical radar performance records, scientific payload specifications, laboratory instrument thermal loads, and ice core preservation monitoring for Antarctic traverse expeditions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ice core preservation monitoring（CORE）
information_points.content:
SCI-CORE-O7K：For the Segmented dual-track modular hauler, the transit refrigeration chamber maintains an archive chamber baseline temperature of -25 degC.
SCI-CORE-U1C：For the Heavy articulated tracked traverse train, the transit refrigeration chamber maintains an archive chamber baseline temperature of -35 degC during transit.
SCI-CORE-WZI：For the High-flotation multi-axle wheeled convoy, the transit refrigeration chamber maintains an archive chamber baseline temperature of -30 degC.

information_points.title: Maintains geophysical radar performance records and laboratory instrument power loads（PAYLOAD）
information_points.content:
SCI-PAYLOAD-TLK：Heavy articulated tracked traverse train in the reporting period October 2025: Ice-sheet radar sounding depth penetration is 2800 m; Laboratory instrumentation thermal load is 18 kW.
SCI-PAYLOAD-0E3：Heavy articulated tracked traverse train in the reporting period September 2025: Ice-sheet radar sounding depth penetration is 2800 m; Laboratory instrumentation thermal load is 24 kW.
SCI-PAYLOAD-FAP：High-flotation multi-axle wheeled convoy in the reporting period September 2025: Ice-sheet radar sounding depth penetration is 2500 m; Laboratory instrumentation thermal load is 12 kW.
SCI-PAYLOAD-XJT：Segmented dual-track modular hauler in the reporting period September 2025: Ice-sheet radar sounding depth penetration is 2000 m; Laboratory instrumentation thermal load is 18 kW.
